subject: Manager Welcome Kit, Practical Roleplay Sessions & Confidential HR Intake
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Manager Welcome Kit, Practical Roleplay Sessions & Confidential HR Intake

Team —

We have a new manager joining next week (Sophie Liang, Eng Manager, start 10/18). I want to coordinate three things before day one: the manager welcome kit, two short roleplay/practice sessions focused on difficult conversations, and a confidential HR intake for a sensitive past-performance topic that Sophie disclosed during hiring.

Asks:
- Monica: can you review the attached welcome kit and make any quick edits for alignment with our performance mgmt expectations? (Attachment: manager-welcome-kit_v2.pdf)
- Rishi & Laura: can you co-run two 45-minute roleplay sessions next Tue/Wed? One on delivering constructive feedback (difficult conversation with IC) and one on escalation/when to involve People Ops. See attached plan (roleplay-session-plan.docx).
- Priya/Stephanie: we need a private HR intake for a prior manager escalation Sophie reported at her last company. This is confidential — Priya, please coordinate the intake with Carolyn (external HR consultant) and confirm whether we need any restricted access notes or evidence collection before Sophie starts. Attach HR intake form (hr-intake-form.pdf).

Timeline: please reply with availability and any edits by EOD Monday so I can finalize calendar invites and vendor booking. If anything looks like it needs legal/extra review, flag to me directly.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manager-welcome-kit_v2.pdf] [Attachment: roleplay-session-plan.docx] [Attachment: hr-intake-form.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manager Welcome Kit, Practical Roleplay Sessions & Confidential HR Intake

Thanks Vivek — quick read done, high level notes here:

- Welcome kit: looks great. I made small edits to the performance calibration section (language and one example). Suggest adding a one-page checklist for first-30/60/90 day expectations (I can draft).
- Roleplay sessions: available Tue 10/13 10:00–10:45 PT and Wed 10/14 14:00–14:45 PT. Rishi/Laura confirm? I recommend keeping groups small (3–4 participants) and including one CS/product observer.
- HR intake: Priya — happy to keep the intake private. For evidence, suggest we only ask for redacted notes from Sophie's prior manager and a brief chronology; Carolyn can advise what else is reasonable to request pre-start.

I will attach the checklist draft when ready.

Monica
People Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Edits: manager-welcome-kit_v2.pdf (tracked)]

From: Carolyn Shaw <cshaw@hrconsults.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manager Welcome Kit, Practical Roleplay Sessions & Confidential HR Intake

Hi Priya / Vivek / Monica —

Thanks for including BrightPath. We can run two 45-minute practical roleplay sessions on the proposed days. Availability confirmed: Tue 10/13 10:00–10:45 PT and Wed 10/14 14:00–14:45 PT. Our facilitator will be Jessica Hale.

On the confidential intake: we recommend a short, structured call (30 minutes) with Priya + Sophie + Carolyn (me) to collect chronology and any documentation. Please do not copy this into broader team calendars; label the session as "Private HR Intake — Confidential".

Fee estimate (one-time): facilitator + prep = $1,200. Invoice will follow (vendor-invoice_#BP-879.pdf). We require a signed vendor engagement form; I'll send that as a separate email.

Regards,
Carolyn Shaw
Senior Consultant, BrightPath Learning
[Attachment: vendor-invoice_BP-879.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manager Welcome Kit, Practical Roleplay Sessions & Confidential HR Intake

All — thank you. Confirming next steps: 

- Monica: please finalize the 1-page 30/60/90 checklist by EOD Monday and drop into the Drive folder (link below).
- Rishi + Laura: confirm you're able to co-run both sessions; if so I'll add a note for observers (small group only) and put them on Sophie's calendar as "Practical Manager Roleplay (invited)".
- Priya: please schedule the Private HR Intake with Sophie and Carolyn for Tue 10/13 11:00–11:30 PT and mark the invite as private. Use hr-intake-form.pdf as the pre-call fillable; instruct Sophie to return it directly to you (not to the broader team).
- Finance/Procurement: Monica, please route Carolyn's engagement form/invoice through contracts — I'll approve the one-time fee.

Priya — a couple of sensitive notes for the intake: do not ask Sophie for prior employer PII (SSN, salary history). We just need a factual chronology and any redacted notes on the escalations. If you think legal should review the intake notes before retention, flag that and I'll loop in Legal.

Thanks everyone — I want Sophie to feel supported but also to ensure we have the right guardrails around performance mgmt coaching early.

Vivek
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
